keyword.zh: 电动60细石600米是不是垂直高度

title.en: How Electric 60 Prints the Fine-Stone Height
title.zh: 电动60怎样印出细石高度

description.en: Electric 60's fine-stone cell is 200 m / 600 m under a horizontal-then-vertical label. 600 m is the vertical figure on that row only.
description.zh: 电动60的细石格在先水平后垂直的标题下是 200 m / 600 m。600 m 只是这一行的垂直数字。

h1.en: How Electric 60 Prints the Fine-Stone Height
h1.zh: 电动60怎样印出细石高度

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Electric 60 concrete pump fine-stone line in Xingtai as 200 m / 600 m under a horizontal / vertical label. Horizontal on that row is 200 m. Vertical on that row is 600 m. The same page prints 13 mm stone at 150 m / 450 m and 24 mm stone at 100 m / 300 m. The 600 m figure is not the height for every stone size, and it is not Electric 80's vertical cell.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60混凝土泵的细石行印成水平/垂直标题下的 200 m / 600 m。这一行的水平是 200 m。这一行的垂直是 600 m。同一页的 13 mm 石子是 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 石子是 100 m / 300 m。600 m 不是每种石子的高度，也不是电动80的垂直格。

heading.en: Only the fine-stone row carries 600 m

body.en: Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h and 35 MPa as well. None of those cells is a height. The 600 m sits in the second position of the fine-stone pair. Hebei Pinjin Machinery also prints a 0.7 m³ hopper on this concrete pump, which is volume, not height.
body.zh: 电动60还印 90 kW、40 m³/h 和 35 MPa。这些格子都不是高度。600 m 位于细石数对的第二个位置。河北品锦机械还在这台混凝土泵上印了 0.7 m³ 料斗，那是容积，不是高度。

body.en: 13 mm stone is 150 m / 450 m. 24 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. Both keep horizontal first. Using 600 m with 24 mm stone would ignore the row that actually prints 100 m / 300 m.
body.zh: 13 mm 石子是 150 m / 450 m。24 mm 石子是 100 m / 300 m。两行都是水平在前。把 600 m 用在 24 mm 石子上，等于无视实际印着 100 m / 300 m 的那一行。

heading.en: A different page can print a higher horizontal
heading.zh: 另一页可以印出更大的水平

body.en: Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m, so its horizontal is 900 m and its vertical is 300 m. That vertical is not 600 m. Keep the concrete pump page you opened.
body.zh: 电动80印 900 m / 300 m，所以它的水平是 900 m，垂直是 300 m。那个垂直不是 600 m。请留在你打开的混凝土泵页面。

answer.en: No. On the Electric 60 fine-stone label it is the vertical figure.
answer.zh: 不是。在电动60细石标题下它是垂直数字。

question.en: What height applies to 24 mm stone?
question.zh: 24 mm 石子对应的高度是多少？

answer.en: The 24 mm row prints 100 m / 300 m, so the vertical figure on that row is 300 m.
answer.zh: 24 mm 行印的是 100 m / 300 m，所以这一行的垂直数字是 300 m。

question.en: What motor is on this page?

answer.en: 90 kW. Output is 40 m³/h and outlet pressure is 35 MPa.
answer.zh: 90 kW。产量 40 m³/h，出口压力 35 MPa。
